# AES-256-GCM interop vector, generated by CryptoKit on macOS.
#
# The Windows side decrypts with BCrypt. If the two disagree on nonce or tag
# placement, every packet fails authentication and nothing works at all -- so
# CI decrypts this on Windows and checks it round-trips.
#
# Plaintext is a real MOVE packet: type=1, seq=1, dx=+5, dy=-3
key        000102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f101112131415161718191a1b1c1d1e1f
plaintext  01000000010005fffd
combined   a0a1a2a3a4a5a6a7a8a9aaabe7187c2d44cb07409f702b017be04f28218f826355564cf80a
